questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: What is the capital of India?
questions.explanation: New Delhi is the capital of India.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is commonly called the Red Planet.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Constitution of India came into effect on which date?
questions.explanation: It came into effect on 26 January 1950.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who wrote the national anthem of India?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote Jana Gana Mana.
